generate_totp_code.description: Get the current six-digit two-factor code for a test account: the code Google Authenticator or Authy would show for it, so a scripted sign-in can get past its 2FA step. You supply the account's own secret, the key its authenticator was set up with or the otpauth link in its QR code; this action does not make one up. That secret is sent to DummyJSON's servers to work the code out, and whoever holds it can make the account's codes for good, so use this only with a test account's secret, never a real account's. The example, JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP, is the public test secret from DummyJSON's docs. No API key required.
generate_totp_code.display_name: Generate a 2FA code for a test account
generate_totp_code.display_str_template: Generate a 2FA code for a test account with DummyJSON.
generate_totp_code.name: generate_totp_code

parameters.description: The test account's own authenticator secret: the base32 key shown when its 2FA was set up (spaces are fine), or the whole otpauth://totp link from its QR code. It goes to DummyJSON as it is, so never enter a real account's secret. From a link only the secret is sent, not the account name or issuer. DummyJSON makes 6-digit, 30-second SHA-1 codes, so a link asking for any other kind is refused.
parameters.name: secret

list_webhook_requests.description: List what a test webhook has received, newest first: each request's method, headers, query parameters, body and time. It can wait up to two minutes for something to arrive, and keep only what came in after a given moment. DummyJSON keeps a webhook's latest 100 requests, and keeps JSON and form bodies only. No API key required.

parameters.description: The test webhook's address or its id, as Create a test webhook returned them, e.g. https://dummyjson.com/webhook/0f02351d. A webhook lasts 24 hours.

description: Free fake data and developer tools for testing and prototyping, from DummyJSON. Products with prices, discounts and reviews, shopping carts, whole user profiles, posts, comments, to-dos, recipes and quotes, all searchable, filterable and paged. Add, change and delete steps are answered as though they worked without anything being stored, and any of the fake users can log in for a real access token. The tools make placeholder images and identicons, answer with any HTTP status, serve your own JSON from a mock endpoint, record what is sent to a test webhook and generate two-factor codes for test accounts. No account or API key required.
